name: Micro UI (repository brand; audit covers this local UI system only)
source: DESIGN.md:17-31 (identity constraints and local source-of-truth boundary)
assets/brand/micro-logo/README.md:1-25 (owner-approved v1 brand asset and explicit uninstalled-in-UI status)
assets/brand/micro-logo/v1/README-AR.md:27-45,62-66 (logo palette, geometry, clear space, and digital size guidance)

profile_limits.status: PARTLY DEFINED; source-derived audit profile, not owner-approved brand guidelines
profile_limits.role_mapping: The skill's primary/secondary/tertiary are measured-area roles, not source token names. Primary is the dominant page/surface field; secondary is supporting petrol ink/surface; tertiary is limited terracotta emphasis. The source token --micro-brand-primary remains petrol (#164D59).
derived_fields: icon grid, live area, corner radius, and permitted-size summary
imagery direction and distinctive asset absence
logo minimum and clear-space policy (not specified by the repository)
not_inferred: No photo/illustration campaign or brand imagery guidelines are specified.
No separate future consumer-product UI or user requirements are inferred.

primary.name: Page ground (audit role)
primary.role: derived dominant field: page canvas and large light surfaces

secondary.name: Petrol (source brand primary)
secondary.role: derived supporting role: action ink and high-emphasis surfaces

tertiary.name: Terracotta
tertiary.role: derived limited accent role: selected emphasis and sparse decorative marker; never runtime warning

extended.name: Support petrol
extended.role: supporting gradient/decorative color; not small white-text background

display.source: First family in the canonical shared CSS stack; Arabic glyphs use the loaded IBM Plex Sans Arabic fallback.

body.source: First family in --micro-font-family; Arabic fallback is IBM Plex Sans Arabic as declared in assets/fonts/fonts.css.

mono.use: IBM Plex Sans with tabular-nums for numeric comparison

type.scale_note: Core roles from docs/UI-VISUAL-SYSTEM.md:19-22 plus sizes observed in implemented component and preview contexts; this audit-tool allowlist is not a proposal that every size become a universal typography token. Core text roles remain 13/14/16/18/22px, with a 36px primary numeric reading.

icons.metaphors: Functional interface metaphors; no repository-defined proprietary icon metaphor set.
icons.base_set: HugeIcons Stroke Rounded, with locally vendored SVG assets
icons.limits: The icon auditor's one-stroke ideal is a measurement profile, not a claim that every status mark, check, chart glyph, or compact icon uses identical geometry.

pillars: Derived: exact about values and states

examples.good: Example text should identify the value, state, or available action plainly.
examples.bad: Claims about a real product journey, saved account, or user result not supported by this UI-kit repository.

voice.limits: The repository defines a visual system, not owner-approved brand voice guidelines. UI copy in previews is fixture/demo content and is not treated as verified brand-channel copy.

imagery.kind: No brand photography direction is defined; local UI examples use CSS/SVG surface motifs.
imagery.palette: Use repository surface and semantic tokens only where an illustration needs color.
imagery.treatment: No general image treatment contract identified.
imagery.avoid: Invented proprietary photography, logo, mascot, or future product imagery.

logo.status: Owner-approved brand asset exists under assets/brand/micro-logo/v1; repository documentation says it has not yet been installed into UI screens.
logo.source: assets/brand/micro-logo/v1/source/micro-brand-master.svg (canonical editable source); derived export assets in assets/brand/micro-logo/v1/exports/svg/
logo.min_px_scope: Full lockup width in CSS px. Below that, the approved guidance says to use the symbol alone; physically test its context before setting a permanent minimum.
logo.clear_space: 0.3125 × symbol width between symbol and wordmark; 40-unit outer margins in the approved source composition. See v1/README-AR.md:39-45.
logo.placement_note: No UI placement contract is specified. Any preview/showcase placement is an owner decision.

distinctive_assets: Approved four-part geometric Micro symbol (two petrol segments, terracotta and blue-petrol segments) — assets/brand/micro-logo/v1/source/micro-brand-master.svg
Custom outlined Arabic and English Micro lockups drawn as editable vector paths, not font text — assets/brand/micro-logo/v1/README-AR.md:7-14
